blind_spots.blind_spot: The neuromorphic/SNN compute story has no named hardware, and therefore no qualification or accreditation path
blind_spots.operator_reality: The first question a C3BM integrator asks is which board this runs on — and spiking-neural-net silicon has no MIL-STD-810/461 qualification, no place on an approved parts list, and no ATO precedent on an Air Force network. 'Platform-agnostic' means the integration burden lands entirely on the government, which is how a promising demo becomes an unfunded science project. Naming a target compute module now, and qualifying against the actual host platform's power and EMI envelope, is a decision that has to be made before the accelerator money runs out.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Neuromorphic processing is genuinely the right answer for always-on inference at low power, and that technical correctness makes it easy to skip the question of whether any fieldable, accreditable instance of it exists today.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Our platform-agnostic edge AI engine combines: Multi-Modal Sensor Fusion ... Neuromorphic Processing

blind_spots.blind_spot: Semantic compression is defined by what it discards, but they never state what fidelity the receiving C2 system contractually requires
blind_spots.operator_reality: This is the 30fps crowd-detection failure mode inverted: compressing to survive a 1-frame-every-5-seconds link is correct engineering right up until the analyst at the other end cannot make a positive identification and the capability gets rejected in test. Worse, there is no output format named — a fused operational picture that does not emit Cursor-on-Target has nowhere to land in the Air Force C2 stack, so the demo shows a beautiful screen that no fielded system can consume.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Compression ratio is a demo-friendly number and interoperability is a paperwork-heavy one, so the first gets engineered and the second gets a paragraph about 'advanced APIs'.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Semantic Compression: Dramatically reduces data volume while preserving mission-critical meaning, enabling real-time intelligence transmission over degraded or bandwidth-limited links.

blind_spots.blind_spot: The BeAST bundles physiological monitoring and CBRNE agent detection into one wearable with no sustainment or data-authority story
blind_spots.operator_reality: Nerve and blister agent sensors are consumables with calibration cycles and shelf lives — somebody has to recalibrate them, stock spares, and certify the detection threshold, or the device becomes a decoration that nobody trusts to call a chemical alarm. Separately, continuous vitals on named service members is health data under DHA policy and needs a records and privacy determination before a single unit fields. Both are answerable in weeks if scoped now and fatal if discovered at the transition review.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The founding team's depth is offshore oil and gas and commercial hardware, where a safety wearable ships to a customer and the customer owns sustainment — the military model, where a unit supply sergeant owns it, works nothing like that.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: BeAST design modularly includes the detection of harmful gases, nerve and blister agents integrated into low SWaP & human wearable form factors

opener_hook: Griffiss handed AugSense the $155,000 top prize in HUSTLE Cohort 5 on May 1 for edge AI on C3BM, and the site describes the engine as platform-agnostic neuromorphic inference — in my experience that is the exact point where the transition stalls, because the program office needs a named compute module it can qualify, not an architecture.
what_they_do: Six-person Colorado pre-seed building edge AI and multi-sensor fusion that runs without connectivity, plus an on-ear wearable that tracks operator vitals, blast exposure, and chemical threats.
